ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p446/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p446/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p446/r5.claim: The concluding discourse returns to the sūrah's opening theme: Qur'anic warnings are true, punishment signs can come, and prophetic histories already serve as signs for the stubborn Quraysh.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p446/r5.anchor: Coming up are the concluding verses of the sūrah and the discourse links to its introductory part which is the real theme.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r8.claim: The conditional divides outcomes: those who follow receive humility, while those who disobey are disavowed for their idolatry and worship of other gods.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r8.anchor: ولما كان الإنذار يترتب عليه إما الطاعة وإما العصيان، جاء التقسيم عليهما

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r9.claim: Another reading takes the pronoun as referring to believing followers who disobey Islamic rulings; the Prophet should reject their actions, not them personally, to remain an intercessor for sinners.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r9.anchor: وقيل: الضمير يعود على من اتبعه من المؤمنين، أي فإن عصوك يا محمد في الأحكام

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r10.claim: Abū Ḥayyān says this truce-like instruction was abrogated by the sword verse.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p196/r10.anchor: وفي هذا موادعة نسختها آية السيف

RAZI-FULL:v24p148#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v24p148#3/r1.speaker: الجبائي
RAZI-FULL:v24p148#3/r1.claim: Al-Jubbāʾī argues that the Prophet’s disavowal of their sins entails God’s disavowal too; otherwise God would contradict His Messenger, and a God who disavows their acts cannot create or will them.
RAZI-FULL:v24p148#3/r1.anchor: قال الجبائي هذا يدل على أنه عليه السلام كان بريئا من معاصيهم

RAZI-FULL:v24p148#3/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v24p148#3/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v24p148#3/r2.claim: Rāzī answers that God disavows sins by forbidding rather than commanding them, but does will their occurrence: His knowledge of an event makes it necessary, and the necessary cannot be willed not to occur.
RAZI-FULL:v24p148#3/r2.anchor: أنه تعالى بريء من المعاصي بمعنى أنه ما أمر بها بل نهى عنها

BURSEVI:v6p227/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p227/r1.speaker: كشف الأسرار
BURSEVI:v6p227/r1.claim: The verse was revealed when the Prophet’s relatives persisted in hostility toward him and spoke abusively.

BURSEVI:v6p227/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p227/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p227/r2.claim: If the Prophet’s clan leaves obedience and does not follow him, he is to state that plainly.
BURSEVI:v6p227/r2.anchor: {فإن عصوك} أي : فإن خرجت عشيرتك عن الطاعة وخالفوك ولم يتبعوك

BURSEVI:v6p227/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p227/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p227/r3.claim: Disavow their worship of other than God, not the people themselves; counsel them gently in hope that they return.
BURSEVI:v6p227/r3.anchor: أي : من عبادتكم لغير الله تعالى ولا تبرأ منهم وقل لهم قولا معروفا بالنصح والعظة لعلهم يرجعون

BURSEVI:v6p227/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p227/r4.speaker: شيخي وسندي
BURSEVI:v6p227/r4.claim: Bursevī’s shaykh said he had severed ties with his successors except by testament, since he must counsel all in truth and patience, especially them.
BURSEVI:v6p227/r4.anchor: يقول : قطعت الوصلة بيني وبين خلفائي إلا من الوصية فإن الله تعالى يقول : {وتواصوا بالحق وتواصوا بالصبر}

STUDYQURAN:26:216/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:216/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:26:216/r1.claim: The Prophet’s disavowal means he is not responsible for the disobedient and is innocent of their wrongs.
STUDYQURAN:26:216/r1.anchor: means that the Prophet is not

STUDYQURAN:26:216/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:216/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:26:216/r2.claim: The Quran says the Prophet answers for warning his people and bringing glad tidings, not for their sins.
STUDYQURAN:26:216/r2.anchor: he is only responsible for warning them and bringing them glad tidings

TAB-FULL:v17p665#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v17p665#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v17p665#2/r1.claim: If the Prophet’s closest kin refuse his warning and persist in worshipping idols and associating partners with God, he should disavow their deeds.
TAB-FULL:v17p665#2/r1.anchor: الأوثان، والإشراك بالرحمن، فقل لهم: {إني بريء مما تعملون}

TABATABAI:26:215-223/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:215-223/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:215-223/r2.claim: Following means obedience: the Prophet should nurture those who believe and obey, and disavow the deeds of those who disobey.
TABATABAI:26:215-223/r2.anchor: والمراد بالاتباع الطاعة بقرينة قوله في الآية التالية { فإن عصوك فقل إني بريء

TABRISI:26:215-219/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:215-219/r8.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:215-219/r8.claim: The disobedient are Muhammad's relatives if they reject his warning and oppose his call.
TABRISI:26:215-219/r8.anchor: يعني أقاربك في إنذارك إياهم وخالفوك فيما تدعوهم إليه

TABRISI:26:215-219/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:215-219/r9.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:215-219/r9.claim: He should disavow their vile deeds and their worship of idols.
TABRISI:26:215-219/r9.anchor: أي من أعمالكم القبيحة وعبادتكم الأصنام

THALABI:v7p183/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v7p183/r3.speaker: author
THALABI:v7p183/r3.claim: If they disobey, Muhammad is to disavow their worship of idols and disobedience to the Merciful.
THALABI:v7p183/r3.anchor: فإن عصوك فقل إني بريء مما تعملون من عبادة الأوثان ومعصية الرحمن

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r1.claim: Those who disobey the Prophet are his close relatives.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r2.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r2.claim: Muqātil specifies Banū Hāshim and Banū al-Muṭṭalib.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r2.anchor: وقال مقاتل: يعني بني هاشم وبني المطلب

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r3.claim: The Prophet disavows their disbelief and worship of other than God.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r3.anchor: أي: من الكفر وعبادة غير الله

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r4.claim: The verse shows that alliance with a polytheist is forbidden in every case, since God commands this even for the Prophet's closest relatives.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p140/r4.anchor: والآية دليل على أن موالاة المشرك حرام بكل حال

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p527/r6.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p527/r6.speaker: الحسن
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p527/r6.claim: Al-Ḥasan reports that after this verse the Prophet called his relatives clan by clan, told Banū ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib he could not protect them from God, and identified the God-fearing as his allies.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p527/r6.anchor: وحدثني أبو الأشهب، عن الحسن أن هذه الآية لما نزلت دعا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عشيرته بطنا بطنا حتى انتهى إلى بني عبد المطلب،

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p527/r7.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p527/r7.speaker: رسول الله
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p527/r7.claim: The Prophet warns his family not to arrive carrying worldly claims while others come carrying the afterlife.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p527/r7.anchor: يا بني عبد المطلب، إني رسول الله إليكم، لي عملي ولكم أعمالكم، إني لا أملك لكم من الله شيئا، إنما أوليائي منكم المتقون، ألا لا أعرفنكم تأتونني تحملون الدنيا على رقابكم، ويأتيني الناس يحملون الآخرة

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p528/r2.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p528/r2.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p528/r2.claim: Those who disobey the Prophet are the polytheists.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p528/r2.anchor: قوله عز وجل: {فإن عصوك} [الشعراء: 216] فإن عصاك المشركون.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p528/r3.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p528/r3.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p528/r3.claim: He is to declare himself free of their deeds.

QASHANI:26:213-216/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:26:213-216/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:26:213-216/r4.claim: If they disobey because veils have thickened, disavow their power and your own through trust in God and annihilation in His acts; none can do what He has not willed.
QASHANI:26:213-216/r4.anchor: { فإن عصوك } لاستحكام الرين وتكاثف الحجاب فتبرأ عن حولهم وقوتهم وحولك وقوتك بالتوكل والفناء في أفعاله تعالى

QASHANI:26:213-216/r5.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:26:213-216/r5.speaker: author
QASHANI:26:213-216/r5.claim: In trust and annihilation witness God's might veiling the disobedient and barring them from faith, and His mercy pouring light on the guided; He veils through majesty and guides through beauty.
QASHANI:26:213-216/r5.anchor: وشاهد في توكلك وفنائك عن أفعالك مصادر أفعاله من العزة التي يقهر بها من يشاء من العصاة

ELMALILI:26:213-223/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:26:213-223/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:26:213-223/r6.claim: If they disobey, meaning they do not pledge allegiance, the Prophet should disown their deeds and refuse responsibility for them.
ELMALILI:26:213-223/r6.anchor: yok sana âsî olurlar, yani bey‘at etmezlerse

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:214/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:214/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:214/r5.claim: Religious leaders should treat followers humbly, compassionately, and well, but should not support them when they adopt a hostile stance toward the faith.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:214/r5.anchor: özellikle din önderlerinin hakkı tebliğ konusunda başarılı olmaları için kendilerine tâbi olan müminlere kol kanat germelerini yani onlara karşı alçak gönüllü, şefkatli, merhametli olmalarını ve iyi davranmalarını

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:214/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:214/r6.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:214/r6.claim: Because disowning rebellious relatives can cool or sour family relations, God tells leaders to disregard hostility, rely on Him, and trust His power and mercy to protect believers.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:214/r6.anchor: Bu sebeple Allah önderlerin, karşılaşacakları düşmanca davranışlara aldırış etmemelerini ve Allah’a dayanıp güvenmelerini öğütlemekte

SULAMI:v2p82/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p82/r1.speaker: الحسين
SULAMI:v2p82/r1.claim: Unlike other prophets, Muhammad disavowed the deeds of disobedient kin without disavowing them personally because of his rank and intercessory station; his intercession lifts sins' darkness from them.
SULAMI:v2p82/r1.anchor: قال الحسين : تبرى كل نبي عن من عصاه من ذريته إلا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لشرف محله فقال : فإن عصوك أي : خالفوك

NAHHAS:v3p193/r14.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v3p193/r14.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v3p193/r14.claim: The Prophet disowns their disobedience to him, since disobeying him is disobeying God: he commands only what God approves, and God disowns whoever opposes Him.
NAHHAS:v3p193/r14.anchor: أي إني بريء من معصيتكم إياي لأن عصيانهم إياه عصيانهم لله جل وعز

SAMIN-DURR:26:216/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:26:216/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:26:216/r1.claim: The plural pronoun in ʿaṣawka may refer to the unbelievers disobeying the call to monotheism.
SAMIN-DURR:26:216/r1.anchor: أنها ضمير الكفار أي: فإن عصاك الكفار في أمرك لهم بالتوحيد

SAMIN-DURR:26:216/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:26:216/r2.speaker: غير مسمى
SAMIN-DURR:26:216/r2.claim: Another view takes the pronoun as the believers disobeying in subsidiary Islamic rulings after believing the Messenger; the author calls this extremely remote.
SAMIN-DURR:26:216/r2.anchor: أنها ضمير المؤمنين أي: فإن عصاك المؤمنون في فروع الإسلام وبعض الأحكام

SAMIN-DURR:26:216/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:26:216/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:26:216/r3.claim: The author judges the interpretation that the pronoun refers to believers as extremely remote.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p447/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p447/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p447/r4.claim: If the deniers reject the message, the Prophet should not let them distract him; he should focus on the believers as the deniers approach their fate.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p447/r4.anchor: If these unfortunate people deny it, the Prophet (sws) should not pay heed to them. Instead he should focus all his attention on the believers.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p454/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p454/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p454/r5.claim: If his kin disobey, the Prophet is to declare disassociation; this is the final warning phase, after which rejection brings messenger punishment and follower migration, as with Abraham before his father.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p454/r5.anchor: This declaration of acquittal is the last phase of warning, as has been stated at other instances.

ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r1.claim: The subject of 'if they disobey you' most apparently refers to the near relatives Muhammad was told to warn in 26:214; if they refuse after warning, he should disavow their deeds or their associating another god.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r1.anchor: الظاهر أن الضمير المرفوع في عصوك عائد على من أنذر صلى الله عليه وسلم بانذارهم وهم العشيرة

ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r2.claim: Alternatively, the pronoun refers generally to the unbelievers understood from the context.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r2.anchor: وجوز أن يكون عائدا على الكفار المفهوم من السياق

ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r3.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r3.claim: Another view addresses believers who disobey Muhammad in rulings and subsidiary Islamic duties after believing him; he should show disapproval of their sins, though this reading is said to cost him his intercession for sinners.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r3.anchor: وقيل : هو عائد على من اتبع من المؤمنين أي فان عصوك يا محمد في الاحكام وفروع الاسلام

ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r4.speaker: ابن زيد
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r4.claim: Ibn Zayd says the command was later abrogated and replaced by the order to fight them.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r4.anchor: أخرج ابن أبي حاتم عن ابن زيد أنه قال : أمره سبحانه بهذا ثم نسخه فامره بجهادهم

ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r5.speaker: البحر
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r5.claim: Al-Bahr likewise calls this a truce later abrogated by the sword verse.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p136/r5.anchor: وفي البحر هذه موادعة نسختها ءاية السيف

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p134/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p134/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p134/r1.claim: If they disobey by disbelieving and worshipping other than God, declare yourself free of what they do.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p134/r1.anchor: {فإن عصوك فقل إني بريء مما تعملون} من الكفر وعبادة غير الله.

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:213-216/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:213-216/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:213-216/r6.claim: If they do not follow you, tell them you disavow what they do or their deeds.
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:213-216/r6.anchor: فإن عصوك } ولم يتبعوك. { فقل إني برىء مما تعملون } بما تعملونه أو من أعمالكم.

BIQAI-FULL:v5p397/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p397/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p397/r9.claim: If these believers disobey, others are included a fortiori; the Prophet must cease the gentleness shown to them as believers and disavow their sinful conduct.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p397/r9.anchor: أي هم فغيرهم من باب الأولى

BIQAI-FULL:v5p397/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p397/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p397/r10.claim: The disavowal is complete separation from their disobedience, the conduct the Qur’an warned against.

DURR-FULL:v6p329/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p329/r7.speaker: ابن زيد
DURR-FULL:v6p329/r7.claim: Ibn Zayd says the instruction to disavow their deeds was later abrogated when the Prophet was commanded to fight them.
DURR-FULL:v6p329/r7.anchor: وفي قوله {فإن عصوك فقل إني بريء مما تعملون} وقال: أمره بهذا ثم نسخه فأمره بجهادهم

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2827#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2827#2/r1.speaker: جعفر بن محمد
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2827#2/r1.claim: Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad says to disavow anyone who speaks of Abu Bakr and Umar except with good, citing the command to disavow their conduct.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2827#2/r1.anchor: سمعت جعفر بن محمد يقول : تبرؤا ممن ذكر أبا بكر وعمر الا بخير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p203/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p203/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p203/r3.claim: If the Prophet's close kin disobey him, he is to disavow their conduct; because this entails estrangement and enmity, God steadies him to rely on his Lord rather than fear them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p203/r3.anchor: والمعنى : فإن عصاك أهل عشيرتك فتبرأ منهم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p244#3/r15.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p244#3/r15.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p244#3/r15.claim: The pronoun in عصوك refers to the assembled members of the Prophet's clan.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p244#3/r15.anchor: والضمير في عصوك عائد على عشيرته من حيث جمعت رجالا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p244#3/r16.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p244#3/r16.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p244#3/r16.claim: The command tells the Prophet to disavow the clan if they disobey him; Ibn ʿAṭiyya says this conciliatory arrangement was abrogated by the sword verse.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p244#3/r16.anchor: فأمره الله بالتبري منهم وفي هذه الآية موادعة نسختها آية السيف

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p148/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p148/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p148/r1.claim: Those who disobey are Muhammad's clan, and he is to disavow their acts of unbelief.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p148/r1.anchor: فان عصوك يعني العشيرة فقل إني برئ مما تعملون من الكفر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p166/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p166/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p166/r3.claim: He is to be gentle toward the believers who follow him and disavow any creature who disobeys, whoever that may be.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p166/r3.anchor: أن يلين جانبه لمن اتبعه من عباد الله المؤمنين. ومن عصاه من خلق الله كائنا من كان فليتبرأ منه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p170/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p170/r4.speaker: أبو الدرداء
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p170/r4.claim: Abū al-Dardāʾ reports hearing the Prophet say that prophets are most detached from worldly life and their closest relatives are hardest on them; he adds that a scholar's family is least interested in his knowledge until he leaves.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p170/r4.anchor: عن عبد الواحد الدمشقي قال: رأيت أبا الدرداء، رضي الله عنه، يحدث الناس ويفتيهم

JISHUMI:v7p5393/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5393/r3.speaker: أبو جعفر ونافع
JISHUMI:v7p5393/r3.claim: Abu Ja'far and Nafi read فتوكل with fāʾ, as in Medinan codices; fāʾ stands in place of the conditional answer: if they disobey, then rely.
JISHUMI:v7p5393/r3.anchor: قرأ أبو جعفر ونافع: فتوكل بالفاء وكذلك في مصاحف المدينة، الباقون بالواو

JISHUMI:v7p5393/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5393/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5393/r6.claim: Barāʾa is separation from giving support when needed, rooted in distance; the text lists plural forms and uses أنا منك براء for singular and plural alike.
JISHUMI:v7p5393/r6.anchor: والبراءة: المباعدة عن النصرة عند الحاجة، وأصله المباعدة، وجمع بريء، برآء على وزن فعلاء

JISHUMI:v7p5393/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5393/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5393/r7.claim: The related expressions for recovering from illness, sharpening a pen away from what is cut, and releasing a debtor all express separation or distancing.
JISHUMI:v7p5393/r7.anchor: ومنه: برأت من المرض كأنه بعد منه، وبرى القلم كأنه باعد ما بين القلم

MUQATIL:26:215-220/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:215-220/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:215-220/r2.claim: Those who disobey are Banu Hashim and Banu Abd al-Muttalib, who did not accept faith; disavowal concerns their polytheism and unbelief.
MUQATIL:26:215-220/r2.anchor: { فإن عصوك } يعنى بنى هاشم، وبنى عبد المطلب، فلم يجيبوك إلى الإيمان

NASAFI-FULL:v3p200#8/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p200#8/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p200#8/r1.claim: If they obey, lower your wing to them; if they disobey and do not follow, disavow them and their deeds, including shirk and anything else they do.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p200#8/r1.anchor: فإن اتبعوك وأطاعوك فاخفض جناحك لهم وإن عصوك ولم يتبعوك فتبرأ منهم ومن أعمالهم من الشرك بالله وغيره

QURTUBI-FULL:26:214-220/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:214-220/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:214-220/r7.claim: If they oppose the Prophet’s command, he must disown their conduct; disobeying him is disobeying God because he commands only what God approves.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:214-220/r7.anchor: { فإن عصوك } أي خالفوا أمرك. { فقل إني بريء مما تعملون } أي بريء من معصيتكم إياي لأن عصيانهم إياه عصيان لله عز وجل

QURTUBI-FULL:26:214-220/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:214-220/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:214-220/r8.claim: Whoever disowns the Prophet’s command is disowned by God.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:214-220/r8.anchor: ومن تبرأ منه فقد تبرأ الله منه
